full_name: Selim Berker | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Selim Berker is an associate professor of philosophy at Harvard University. His primary research interests are in ethics and epistemology, which he sees as two aspects of the same field, ethics being the study of what we ought to do, and epistemology being the study of what we ought to believe.
